statedelta.alt: Conceptual furniture assembly: separate parts become an assembled frame, with the changed attachment traced to evidence and a grounded instruction.
statedelta.caption: Conceptual assembly example illustrating how state changes, components, and attachment evidence can ground an instruction; not a dataset sample or experimental result.

virel-budget.alt: An image-token grid enters a calibrated policy that chooses either a pruned token budget or dense fallback for one VLM call.
virel-budget.caption: Conceptual budget selection. The illustrated token pattern is schematic; the calibrated policy chooses a pruning budget or dense fallback for a single VLM call.

stableeval.alt: A historical evidence window ends at prediction time; the future horizon is locked and reserved for evaluation.
stableeval.caption: Conceptual historical replay: evidence is frozen at prediction time, while future outcomes remain hidden from the agent and are used for evaluation.

molecular-docking.alt: A sparse matrix of molecular complexes and docking algorithms, with observed outcomes, unobserved outcomes, and a runtime-aware next query.
molecular-docking.caption: Conceptual acquisition matrix. Colored cells distinguish observed outcomes from a prospective query; the layout is illustrative and contains no measured docking values.

portfolio-selection.alt: Three alternative representation sources feed RF or MLP selectors for portfolio algorithm selection under asset-family shift.
portfolio-selection.caption: Conceptual comparison of alternative representations, not feature fusion. The portfolio symbols illustrate different asset families; they do not encode measured allocations or returns.
